description: Contract for a river-management structure or gage node sourced from USACE/USGS/NWS open data. Numeric fields are nullable: a null means 'not published by the authority', never an estimate. Consumers must treat nulls as unavailable (fail-closed). This schema describes observations only; it confers no regulatory standing.

gageZeroNavd88Ft.description: Validated gage-zero elevation in NAVD88. Null blocks all datum conversion downstream.

gateStatus.description: Navigation-dam gate position during the observation window.

nodeId.description: Authority site identifier, e.g. USGS 03322000 or NWS UNWK2.

normalPoolNavd88Ft.description: Authorized normal (navigation) pool elevation in NAVD88, where published. Null otherwise.

observedStageFt.description: Latest observed stage in feet, source datum. Null when unpublished.

verticalDatum.description: Datum of observedStageFt as published by the authority, e.g. NAVD88, NGVD29, or 'unknown'.

title: TSM USACE Hydrologic Node
